Visual changes based on actual 0.2.0-beta screenshots and approved references:
- White source tabs with red underline, replacing large pink selected backgrounds.
- Flat white bottom navigation, centered icons/labels and a thin top divider.
- Clear native Button state animator/elevation/tint; flat red and outlined controls.
- Hide global navigation on details, confirmation, results and wireless guide.
- 16dp catalog gutters; image ratios 1.68:1 list and 1.25:1 detail.
- Compact grey USB state with a red phone-file action.
- Remove duplicated unconfigured-catalog messages and prefer existing local content.
- Group detail/confirmation information and center the success composition.
- Link outcome photos to the actual source hash, not just a possibly duplicate name.
- Add neutral device diagrams and three grey wireless guide step areas.
- Compact landscape album empty state; retain scrolling for limited height/font scaling.
